cards.card_text: Paul tells them that as he walked around looking at their objects of worship, he even found an altar with this inscription: TO AN UNKNOWN GOD.
cards.verse_text: For as I walked around and examined your objects of worship, I even found an altar with this inscription: TO AN UNKNOWN GOD.
cards.snippet: For as I walked around and examined your objects of worship, I even found an altar with this inscription: TO AN UNKNOWN GOD.

cards.card_text: What does he tell the Athenians about the One they worship as unknown?
cards.verse_text: For as I walked around and examined your objects of worship, I even found an altar with this inscription: TO AN UNKNOWN GOD.
cards.snippet: For as I walked around and examined your objects of worship, I even found an altar with this inscription: TO AN UNKNOWN GOD.

cards.card_text: Then Paul lists what belongs to Israel: the adoption as sons, the divine glory, the covenants, the law, the temple worship, the promises and the patriarchs.
cards.verse_text: Theirs is the adoption as sons; theirs the divine glory and the covenants; theirs the giving of the law, the temple worship, and the promises.
cards.snippet: …glory and the covenants; theirs the giving of the law, the temple worship, and the promises.

cards.card_text: Paul says offering your body as a living sacrifice is your spiritual service of worship.
cards.verse_text: Therefore I urge you, brothers, on account of God’s mercy, to offer your bodies as living sacrifices, holy and pleasing to God, which is your spiritual service of worship.
cards.snippet: …sacrifices, holy and pleasing to God, which is your spiritual service of worship.

cards.card_text: Paul says these restrictions indeed have an appearance of wisdom, with their self-prescribed worship, their false humility and their harsh treatment of the body.
cards.verse_text: Such restrictions indeed have an appearance of wisdom, with their self-prescribed worship, their false humility, and their harsh treatment of the body; but they are of no value against the indulgence of the flesh.

cards.card_text: True or false: Paul says restrictions with self-prescribed worship, false humility and harsh treatment of the body are of real value against the indulgence of the flesh.

cards.card_text: Paul says the man of lawlessness will exalt himself above every so-called god or object of worship, proclaiming himself to be ___.
cards.verse_text: He will oppose and exalt himself above every so-called god or object of worship.
cards.snippet: …will oppose and exalt himself above every so-called god or object of worship.

cards.card_text: It had rules for worship, plus a sanctuary right here on earth.
cards.verse_text: Now the first covenant had regulations for worship and also an earthly sanctuary.
cards.snippet: Now the first covenant had regulations for worship and also an earthly sanctuary.

cards.card_text: The tabernacle and its worship vessels The city gates and the walls The tents of the twelve tribes
cards.verse_text: In the same way, he sprinkled with blood the tabernacle and all the vessels used in worship.
cards.snippet: …he sprinkled with blood the tabernacle and all the vessels used in worship.
